description.value: Red Card Sports Bar + Eatery occupies a 1908 heritage building in downtown Vancouver, blending original brickwork and restored wood features with contemporary interior design. Part of the Viaggio Hospitality group, it serves Italian-inspired pub food — including wood-fired pizzas from a Marana Forni oven imported from Italy — alongside craft beers, cocktails, and global wines. With 16 HD screens and two 106" projectors, it caters to sports fans and can host private groups of up to 146 people.
